summary: Frontend-only testing of the two new PRO lab tools (Dough Water Temperature calculator, Sourdough & pH Tracker) plus the EN-locale crash regression. Logged in as admin@mikilab.de (PRO) at 430px mobile viewport. All 3 requested feature areas PASS: water-temp formula correct with no focus loss on multi-digit typing, pH tracker ideal-window detection/log/clear/persistence/BT+notification buttons work, and Diagnosi + both tools render in IT/EN/DE with zero JS pageerrors and no error overlay.

ui_bugs.issue: Re-tapping the already-active bottom nav tab 'Il Tuo Laboratorio' while inside a sub-tool does NOT reset to the tools grid (stays inside the open tool). User must use the header back link. Minor UX inconsistency.
Entered pH 5.0 is stored/displayed as 'pH 5' (Number() drops trailing zero); readings like 4.10 also lose formatting. Cosmetic — consider toFixed(2)/toFixed(1) for display.

issues: Floating Radio/Talk FABs sit above page content near the bottom and visually overlap the reading-history / hero background area; they did not block any tested control but crowd the layout on 430px.

action_items: Optional: make tapping the active Lab nav tab return to the tools grid (setTool(null)).
Optional: format pH display to fixed decimals so 5.0 doesn't render as 5.
critical_code_review_comments: WaterTempCalc: Field is now at module scope — verified no remount/focus-loss regression (typed '26' and '125' with 150ms delay, focus retained).
SourdoughTracker: add() rejects 0 values via falsy check (!p || !t), so a legitimate temperature of 0°C or pH 0 would be rejected — acceptable for this domain but technically a validation smell.
SourdoughTracker persists to localStorage 'mikilab_sourdough_log' correctly; log capped at 50 entries.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows passed (2 low-severity cosmetic/UX findings)

seed_data_creation: Transient pH readings in localStorage only; cleared via ph-clear-btn during test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Language switcher buttons are data-testid lang-it/lang-de/lang-en (visible text is CSS-uppercased lowercase, so get_by_text('IT', exact=True) fails). Bottom nav tab ids: home, ricette, maestro, impara, diagnosi. Inside a Maestro sub-tool you must click the header back label (Strumenti/Werkzeuge/Tools) to return to the grid — nav-tab-maestro does not reset it. Verified values: wtc defaults -> 27C, dough=26 -> 33C, ambient=125 -> -70C with tooCold message. pH 4.2/29 -> PRONTO/READY/BEREIT + success toast + speech; pH 5/24 -> keep monitoring.
rca_of_the_issue: No defects reproduced for the reported regressions: EN locale content[lang] crash is gone (no pageerror in it/en/de on Diagnosi and both tools, including a full reload in EN), and the Field-component remount focus loss is fixed (document.activeElement stayed on wtc-dough/wtc-ambient after multi-digit typing).
